name: Norphel Retreat Restaurant
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine in-house restaurant at Norphel Retreat — set inside a 7-hectare orange and kiwi orchard at ~5,000ft. Indian, continental, and pan-Asian on one menu; the fruit on the dessert plate is grown on the property.
insider_tip: Outside guests (not just hotel residents) can book a meal — call ahead. The kiwi season runs October-November; if you're visiting then, ask whether the kiwi crumble is on the dessert list.
signature_address: Near DIET, Rungkhung, Dirang, West Kameng, Arunachal Pradesh 790101

name: Pemaling Lords Inn Restaurant
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine restaurant inside Pemaling Lords Inn — Dirang's most listed mid-range hotel-attached dining option. Reliable rather than distinctive: the place a tour group eats when the homestay isn't doing dinner.
insider_tip: It's a hotel restaurant, not a destination kitchen — order Indian basics, not the continental section. Open to outside diners on a walk-in basis but call after 8pm to confirm.
signature_address: Pemaling Lords Inn, Dirang, West Kameng, Arunachal Pradesh 790101

name: Awoo Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Resort restaurant on the Kameng River bank in Bushtangkha — the dining room with the best river view in Dirang. Standard Indian-Tibetan-Chinese menu but the setting (deck open to the river in summer) is the draw.
insider_tip: The river-side deck is open weather-permitting from April to October; outside that window the indoor seating loses what makes the place worth the drive from Dirang Bazaar (~2km).
signature_address: Bushtangkha, Dirang, West Kameng, Arunachal Pradesh 790101
